side.nota: The Panel sends nothing out of this PC. Only if you use the assistant, a summary goes to the AI you choose.
g1: **Check** what I found on this computer: everything is written below, nothing is hidden.
g2: **AI programs**: turn on, with the switch, the ones the Panel may hook into. «Edit» changes name and command, «Choose folder…» sets where the program keeps its settings, «+ Add program» adds more.
g3: **Folders**: turn on the ones the Panel may read. «Choose folder» opens your Mac's own window (Finder); to also see hidden folders press ⌘⇧. ; you can also type the path by hand.
g4: **Never read**: the list of what is never read (passwords, keys, browsers, messages). You can add or remove entries.
g5: Press **Save**. Everything goes into the file `impostazioni.json`, which you can also open and edit by hand. «Search the PC again» refreshes what it finds without losing your choices.
pc.sub: Information read from the system, not editable. I only read file and folder names, never their content, until you turn a folder on.
prog.sub: Switch = the Panel may hook into it. Tap the coloured badge to change its colour. A «not found» program stays off until it is installed.
agg.sub: Hooks the programs that are on: adds a short block to their instructions file, with your folders and exclusions. Before writing it makes a backup (`.bak-YYYYMMDD`) and shows what changes. «Undo hook-up» removes only the block.
agg.conferma: Remove the Panel block from all programs?
nota.rovinato: block damaged by hand: I won't touch it
col.sub: Reads **only** the folders that are on (never the «Never read» entries) and finds links: projects, copies of the same file and who mentions what. No AI model, nothing is sent. It saves only paths and links, never content, in `collegamenti.md` and `collegamenti.json`.
col.fatto: Done: see collegamenti.md in the Panel folder.
col.nessuna: No folder is on: turn one on below.
cart.sub: Switch = the Panel may use it for links. Type the path by hand; «Choose…» opens the Mac window.
m.finestra: The Mac window is opening: choose the folder
mai.sub: These entries are always excluded, inside any folder. One name per entry (e.g. `.env`, `*.key`, `Documents/Bank`).
mai.ph: Type an entry and press Enter
asp.sub: Change name, theme, colour, language and how many features you see.
m.nonvalido: Invalid data: check names, paths and colours (no empty fields)
dlg.nasc: Also show hidden folders (the ones starting with a dot, e.g. .claude)
h.nessuno: No program hooked: go to System → Hook-up.
h.sub: The Panel starts in simple mode. Change everything from System: programs, folders, language and appearance.
p.fondo: Local · no AI model · refreshes every 30 s
tour.b3: Every program found is here. The **switch** turns it on or off. **Edit** opens name, command and settings folder: change what you like. Tap the coloured badge to change its colour.
tour.b4: If your program is not listed, press **+ Add program**, then type its name and the command that starts it.
tour.b5: **Show what will change** shows, without writing anything, what would be added. **Apply** does it with a backup. **Undo hook-up** removes only the block.
tour.b6: Press **Create links now** to read only the folders that are on and find projects, copies and mentions. The result is in `collegamenti.md`.
tour.b7: The **switch** turns a folder on, **Choose…** opens your Mac's window, **Remove** takes it off the list. You can also type the path by hand.
tour.b8: These entries are never read. Type a name (e.g. `.env`) and press **Enter** to add it; press **×** to remove it.
tour.b9: Change name, theme, colour, **language** and profile (**Simple** or **Full**). Changes show immediately.
tour.b10: Press **Save** to keep your changes. **Search the PC again** refreshes the list without losing your choices. You can take the tour again whenever you like.
mod.sub: Only the features this computer really has are listed. Turn off the ones you don't want to see in the Panel.
ia.sub: Optional. Ask your own AI to suggest a setup that fits this computer. You decide what to apply.
ia.cerca: 1 · Find the AIs on my Mac
ia.nessuna: No AI found. You can set everything up by hand: the assistant is optional.
ia.online: Online service: the summary is sent to this program's provider
ia.consenso: I agree to send the summary to {n}
ia.errore: The AI did not give a usable answer. Try again or set up by hand.
ia.prop: Suggestion: tick what you want to apply
ia.solo: Only this summary is sent: program and folder names, never file contents.
pr.sub: Copy this text and paste it into your AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI…): it explains what PlanAIBoard is and asks the agent to configure and integrate it, always with your approval.
ia.passi: **1.** Find the AIs on your Mac. **2.** Pick one and agree. **3.** Ask for a suggestion, tick what you like and apply.
tour.b1: Optional. **1** find the AIs on your Mac, **2** pick one and agree, **3** ask for a suggestion and tick what to apply. Nothing changes without your OK.
tour.b2: Press **Copy the prompt** and paste it into your AI agent (Claude Code, Codex…): it explains what PlanAIBoard is and guides it to set it up.
